title: Federal Rules of Evidence (Quy tắc Chứng cứ Liên bang)
typeLabel: Quy định / Văn bản dưới luật

versions.text:
Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE).
Article I: General provisions. Rule 102: Purpose.
Article II: Judicial notice. Rule 201.
Article III: Presumptions.
Article IV: Relevance. Rule 401: Test for relevant evidence. Rule 403: Excluding relevant evidence (prejudice).
Article V: Privileges.
Article VI: Witnesses. Rule 602: Need for personal knowledge. Rule 611: Mode and order.
Article VII: Opinions and expert testimony. Rule 702: Expert witness (Daubert standard).
Article VIII: Hearsay. Rule 801: Definitions. Rule 802: The rule against hearsay. Rule 803–807: Exceptions.
